name: Hyundai Motor Securities
note: New Jeonbuk Hyundai uniform partner for 2026 (club announcement, 2026-02-09). Rating note: on hold, with the other Hyundai Motor Group marks on this shirt: the owner is sourced (hyundai-motor-securities-largest-shareholder: Hyundai Motor and its related parties hold 39.94%, the largest shareholder), and the state link doesn't count (South Korea's National Pension Service holds about 7.8% of Hyundai Motor, hyundai-owner-record, and South Korea has no record in this data), but the company test on Hyundai Motor isn't settled. A US Department of Labor Wage and Hour Division investigation found that a 13-year-old worked 50 to 60 hours a week on an assembly line at SMART Alabama, a Hyundai subsidiary, in 2021-22; on 30 May 2024 the department sued Hyundai Motor Manufacturing Alabama, SMART Alabama and a staffing firm in the US District Court for the Middle District of Alabama (AP in Alabama Daily News, 2024-05-31, https://aldailynews.com/us-labor-department-sues-hyundai-suppliers-over-alleged-child-employment/; CBS News, 2024-05-30, https://www.cbsnews.com/news/hyundai-alabama-child-labor-act-labor-deparment/). Korea Daily reported on 2025-11-14 that the court had found Hyundai Motor Manufacturing Alabama 'could be held liable as a joint employer' (https://en.koreadaily.com/hyundai-kia-labor-lawsuit/); no final judgment was found. Held as not rated yet until that case ends (maintainer decision, 2026-09-30), like `hyundai`: a finding against Hyundai Motor would reach this sponsor through its owner (METHOD.md: a record about an owner in the sponsor's chain); if the case ends without one, this sponsor is `none`.
